scope: Operational grouping and timing only. PROTOCOL.json, BUSINESS-METRICS.md, all approved public/private requirements, cause units, five-PR denominators and source/native/image criteria remain unchanged.

admission.private_body_barrier: All ten final source/self-claim/service/resource seals, followed by the controller cohort seal, before any private fixture/lock/sourceDoc/config body access.
admission.hidden_authorization: Use the frozen one-shot authorize-hidden; its durable authorization precedes its first hidden-config open. Fresh contexts, unchanged sealed final source and original resource bounds.
admission.initial_reference: Five fresh canonical references use the genuine initial bytes verified against the pre-render initial capsules, in fresh isolated contexts; never replace or edit a sealed final tree.
admission.inputs: Approved contracts remain exact immutable originals. Preserve every original source, PNG, native fact, failure, unknown, partial packet and pointer/hash mapping.

native_work.order: Serialize all native acquisition/retirement; final hidden arm ordering follows the already declared case/arm order. Initial-reference work is separately identified common oracle research.
native_work.source: Read-only exact final source per arm and exact initial-source reference per case. No public previous/history for hidden evaluation, including the old control.
native_work.contexts: Public review/workflow/task/F state is retained. Hidden and initial-reference review/workflow roots are fresh and disjoint from public, other arms and each other.
native_work.invariants: No added capture-validity window, policy, expected value, sourceDoc, fixture or SUT change. Source/native/image validity and service/quality acceptance remain separate.

anonymous_packets.groups: For each of five cases: one initial group I, and two anonymous final groups X/Y. X/Y-to-arm mapping is kept separately sealed; no mapping is revealed to any judge or matcher before all required quality/cause seals.
anonymous_packets.initial_group: Exact initial source plus genuine public initial observations and the fresh private initial reference. Multiple original initial acquisitions are identified only as repeated observations at the same initial source.
anonymous_packets.final_group: Only that final version's exact source, original public-final and fresh hidden-final images/native facts, and approved public/private contracts.
anonymous_packets.identity_controls: No tool identity/version, A/B arm, cost, worker self-claim, other judge result or original path revealing mapping in first-grade inputs. Preserve real UI labels, values, native facts, expected values and original PNG bytes. Any bounded identity-safe native view records its source file hash and exact value-preserving projection; originals and mapping stay retained separately.
anonymous_packets.coverage: Judges record the actual original images inspected and source/native references for conclusions. Missing/unsupported/full-content-incomplete facts remain U; source or expected text cannot replace an unseen image. Predeclared N/A is distinct from pass.

independent_causes.contexts: Exactly two fresh independent AI contexts per case/source-version group, with the configured parent model and no model override. Each is restricted to its own version and both platforms. This is AI review, not human QA.
independent_causes.first_pass: Both judges independently identify and evidence genuine current causes, measurement/infrastructure limitations and unresolved coverage, without self-claims, alarms selected to suggest an answer or any other grade. Seal each first-pass cause/source/image judgment before delivering alarm material.
independent_causes.global_first_pass_barrier: Seal the complete first-pass grade index before the alarm phase. Preserve every original judgment and explicit later correction rather than overwriting it.
independent_causes.units: Repeated states and atomic rows do not multiply a cause. Separate platform implementations remain separate absent positive shared-source/design-interpretation evidence. Never manufacture faults or a nonzero denominator.

alarms.second_pass: After first-pass seals, the same two independent contexts separately adjudicate bounded anonymous raw-tool/worker alarm packets. They may use the relevant original initial/final source/images, but not another judge's opinion, tool identity or costs.
alarms.classification: Deduplicate product alarms and classify true, false or unresolved against actual evidence. Measurement U, missing coverage, SDK/collector failures and review-binding mistakes are not silently converted to product defects or false alarms. Preserve separate unresolved denominators.
alarms.seals: Seal both independent alarm judgments. Initial-reference/common alarms remain separately identified common research.

correspondence_and_reveal.matcher: A separate fresh anonymous correspondence/adjudication role receives the sealed independent cause/alarm judgments and the necessary unchanged raw source/contract/image evidence. It records case/platform cause correspondence, positive shared-cause evidence, residual/new-regression relations, agreements and unresolved disagreements.
correspondence_and_reveal.no_self_grade: The operations coordinator does not invent quality judgments, fill P from expected values or force consensus. Unresolved mandatory quality remains incomplete delivery.
correspondence_and_reveal.barrier: Seal all independent grades, alarm judgments and common-cause/correspondence decisions before any X/Y-to-arm mapping reveal. Then compute metrics with unchanged definitions and all five attempts per arm.

clocks.primary: Original D0 enqueue through each own public self-seal remains the primary delivery clock, with every queue/review/error/correction/retirement/common-supervision interval retained. Source windows never reset.
clocks.native_hidden_episode: Record each final arm/case's serialized hidden acquisition/check/retirement episode start/end, exact commands, inputs, originals and failures. Record common initial-reference episodes separately.
clocks.grade_episodes: Process one anonymous version group at a time with its two independent judges in parallel. Record first-grade episode start through both cause seals, and later alarm episode start through both alarm seals; record inter-episode/research-barrier waiting separately.
clocks.final_binding_episode: Record the final version's original-fact frozen source/image/native evaluation projection and verification work separately. No new SDK acquisition or public-task clearing is implied by a projection.
clocks.per_arm_hidden_cost: For each final arm, sum its actually measured nonoverlapping hidden-native, final-grade, alarm and final-binding episodes. Keep every underlying clock. Common I/oracle, design/initial authorship, common-cause matching and other shared research are separate, with no arbitrary allocation to a treatment.
clocks.successful_delivery: Use the fixed all-five-attempt public-wall/complete-delivery ratio; additionally report per-arm hidden validation and the combined ratio including that measured per-arm cost. Zero complete deliveries gives N/A, never zero. Always show all-attempt total wall. Actual model billing, tokens and monetary human labor are unmeasured, not zero.
clocks.disk: Keep both original meters running through bulk archive and positive owned cleanup. Retain allocated_bytes, report GiB=bytes/2^30 as sampled observed peaks/lower bounds and state scope; do not add nonsimultaneous group peaks.

publication: Only after quality/cause/reveal closure: immutable explicit archives, independent byte verification/virtual restoration/pure replay, positive owned cleanup, final complete CI, safe remote fast-forward publication and final default-branch/CI verification. No further user permission is required by the existing authorization.
